proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON EFFECTS OF FOOD WASTE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report on environmental and social impacts of food waste generated from company operations.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on effects of food waste.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON CUSTOMER USE OF CERTAIN TECHNOLOGIES
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party report assessing customer due diligence on whether use of surveillance and cloud products contributes to human rights violations.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on customer use of certain technologies.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON POTENTIAL CUSTOMER MISUSE OF CERTAIN TECHNOLOGIES
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent study of Rekognition covering privacy, civil rights, sales to repressive governments and financial risks, published by September 2020.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on potential customer misuse of certain technologies.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON EFFORTS TO RESTRICT CERTAIN PRODUCTS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on efforts to address hate speech and sale or promotion of offensive products, including policy development and enforcement mechanisms.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that shareholders vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A MANDATORY INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIR POLICY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director who has not previously served as an executive officer.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a mandatory independent board chair policy.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ALTERNATIVE REPORT ON GENDER/RACIAL PAY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender/racial pay gap and associated risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an alternative report on gender/ racial pay.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON CERTAIN COMMUNITY IMPACTS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on efforts to identify and reduce disproportionate environmental and health harms from pollution to communities of color.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on certain community impacts.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON VIEWPOINT DISCRIMINATION
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating risks and costs of discriminating against social, political and religious viewpoints.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on viewpoint discrimination.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON PROMOTION DATA
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report disclosing promotion velocity rates by title, level, gender and race.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a report on promotion data.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING AN ADDITIONAL REDUCTION IN THRESHOLD FOR CALLING SPECIAL SHAREHOLDER MEETINGS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendment giving holders of 20% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting an additional reduction in threshold for calling special shareholder meetings.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A SPECIFIC SUPPLY CHAIN REPORT FORMAT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests publication of Human Rights Impact Assessments on high-risk products sold by Amazon, evaluating supply chain human rights impacts.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting a specific supply chain report format.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING ADDITIONAL REPORTING ON LOBBYING
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing lobbying policies, payments for direct, indirect and grassroots lobbying, and decision-making oversight.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting additional reporting on lobbying.
